Qualification and age limit vary according to the post, as specified in the official notification. Multimodal Artificial Intelligence-based early-stage Prediction of Temporomandibular Disorders (TMD) by integrating Dietary Habits, Psychosocial Factors, and Image Analysis
Project Research Scientist – II (Medical), Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support - III
Rs. 28,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month plus HRA / accommodation as applicable

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification offers a total of 5 temporary positions distributed across different posts and hosting institutes as detailed below:

rows.hosting_institute_location: One each at PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur, Govt. Dental College Raipur (CG), and Hitkarini Dental College & Hospital, Jabalpur

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the post-wise essential qualifications and age criteria established for the project: Desirable and Other Qualifications: Project Research Scientist – II (Medical): Candidates having knowledge and experience in clinical analysis of TMD will be preferred. Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical): Preference will be given to candidates having good knowledge in Finite Element Modelling and analysis / AI/ML and biomedical engineering, particularly related to TMJ. Selected candidates may have the opportunity to register for a regular Ph.D. program (PS category) at IIITDM Jabalpur as per Institute norms. Project Technical Support - III: Candidates having good knowledge in (1) text and multimodal data handling, CAD modelling, and willing to perform field studies and /OR (2) having experience in oral/dentistry and willing to assist in clinical evaluation will be preferred.

rows.essential_qualification: BDS with three years post-qualification experience OR MBBS/BDS + Postgraduate Degree (MD/MS/MDS/MPH) or equivalent including integrated PG degree OR MBBS/BDS with PhD.
M.Tech. OR a postgraduate engineering degree including integrated PG degrees (preferably in Mechanical Engineering). Preference for GATE/NET qualified candidates.
BTech / BE / equivalent four-year degree OR BDS / Three-year graduate degree in relevant field + three-year post-qualification experience OR a PG Degree.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All positions are purely temporary, initially for one year and renewable annually subject to satisfactory performance up to a maximum of four years or project completion. Increments of 5% on initial emoluments are provided after every two years subject to performance review. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the interview.

rows.monthly_emoluments: Rs. 80,000/- per month plus HRA as per funding agency rules.
Rs. 56,000/- per month plus accommodation (if available) or HRA.
Rs. 28,000/- per month plus accommodation (if available) or HRA.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Jabalpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Access the online application link provided in the official notification. Fill out the Google form with correct personal, educational, and professional details. Ensure all mandatory fields are completed before the application deadline. Submit the form online on or before 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on qualifications, followed by a skill test and an interview. The skill test and interview for shortlisted candidates will be conducted on 13 November 2026 (Friday) at PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur, Dumna Airport Road, Jabalpur 482005. Exact timings will be communicated to shortlisted candidates via email.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in IIITDM Jabalpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies have been announced across Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support posts.

faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates followed by a skill test and an interview.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on the last date of application.
